M1_SET_store_value.spec: Accept SET <key> <value> and store the value.
M1_SET_store_value.evidence: _handle_set (L99-114): key=args[0], value=' '.join(args[1:]) preserves multi-word values, stores in self._data, sets self._expiry[key]=None, returns 'OK'.
edge_cases_verified: SET clears any previous SETEX expiry

M2_GET_return_or_error.spec: Accept GET <key>, return the stored value or ERR key_not_found.
M2_GET_return_or_error.evidence: _handle_get (L116-122): calls _is_expired first (expired keys auto-cleaned), then checks key in self._data. Returns value on success, 'ERR key_not_found' on miss.
edge_cases_verified: expired key returns ERR key_not_found (not stale value)

M3_DEL_remove_or_error.spec: Accept DEL <key>, remove the key, return ERR key_not_found if missing.
M3_DEL_remove_or_error.evidence: _handle_del (L124-137): two-phase atomic — Phase 1 verifies all keys exist (any missing → ERR key_not_found), Phase 2 deletes all. Returns 'OK <count>' per Response Format 'OK <detail>' allowance.
M3_DEL_remove_or_error.note: Implementation supports multi-key DEL as an extension beyond spec (spec only defines single-key DEL). Single-key DEL returns 'OK 1' (valid OK <detail> format per spec §Response Format). M3 core contract (delete existing key; ERR on missing) is satisfied. Existing test assertion 'OK' in r is forward-compatible.
edge_cases_verified: partially-missing keys → atomic rejection of all

M4_KEYS_list.spec: Accept KEYS (no arguments), return all stored keys one per line, terminated by END.
M4_KEYS_list.evidence: _handle_keys (L139-145): calls _cleanup_all_expired to remove stale keys before listing. Empty store returns just 'END'. Non-empty: keys joined by newline + '\nEND'.

M6_EXISTS_true_false.spec: Accept EXISTS <key>, return TRUE if the key exists, FALSE otherwise.

M7_FLUSH_clear_all.spec: Accept FLUSH (no arguments), remove all stored keys, return OK.
M7_FLUSH_clear_all.evidence: _handle_flush (L158-162): clears both self._data and self._expiry dicts, returns 'OK'.

M8_OK_for_SET_DEL.spec: Return OK for successful SET and DEL operations.
M8_OK_for_SET_DEL.evidence: _handle_set returns 'OK' (L114). _handle_del returns 'OK <count>' (L137), which conforms to 'OK <detail>' in spec §Response Format.
M8_OK_for_SET_DEL.note: DEL response changed from 'OK' to 'OK 1' (single key) or 'OK N' (multi key) due to multi-key extension. Both are valid under the Response Format's 'OK <detail>' pattern. Existing test uses substring 'OK' in r and remains compatible.

M9_unknown_command.spec: Return ERR unknown_command for any unrecognized command.
M9_unknown_command.evidence: execute() (L61-79): three guard clauses — empty command (L62-63), cmd not in COMMAND_MAP (L69-71), arg count below min_parts (L74-75). All return 'ERR unknown_command'.

M10_key_too_long.spec: Reject keys exceeding maximum length with ERR key_too_long.
M10_key_too_long.evidence: MAX_KEY_LENGTH=64. Checked in _handle_set (L105), _handle_mset (L181), _handle_setex (L256), _handle_append (L222), _handle_rename (L296). len(key)>64 rejected, len(key)≤64 accepted.

M11_value_too_large.spec: Reject values exceeding maximum size with ERR value_too_large.
M11_value_too_large.evidence: MAX_VALUE_SIZE=1024. Checked in _handle_set (L107), _handle_mset (L183), _handle_setex (L258), _handle_append for new keys (L232) and post-concatenation (L227).
edge_cases_verified: APPEND concatenated overflow → original value preserved

M12_store_full.spec: Reject SET when at capacity with ERR store_full, unless key already exists (update allowed).
M12_store_full.evidence: MAX_KEYS=100. Checked in _handle_set (L109): len(_data)>=100 AND key not in _data → ERR store_full. Updates to existing keys always allowed.
edge_cases_verified: APPEND new key at capacity → ERR store_full

S1_MSET_atomic.evidence: _handle_mset (L166-201): two-phase atomic. Phase 1 pre-validates all pairs (key length, value size, deduplicated new-key capacity). Phase 2 commits all. Returns f'OK {len(pairs)}'.
edge_cases_verified: MSET a 1 a 2 b 3 → correct dedup (3 pairs, only 2 new keys for capacity)

S2_MGET_multi_get.spec: Accept MGET <k1> <k2> ..., value or NIL per line, terminated by END.
S2_MGET_multi_get.evidence: _handle_mget (L203-213): iterates args, returns self._data[key] or 'NIL', appends 'END'.
edge_cases_verified: all keys missing → NIL per line + END

S3_TTL_time_to_live.spec: Accept TTL <key>, return seconds or -1 (no expiry) or ERR key_not_found.
S3_TTL_time_to_live.evidence: _handle_ttl (L267-282): calls _is_expired, returns '-1' for no expiry, remaining int seconds for expiring keys, '0' for already-expired edge case, 'ERR key_not_found' for missing.

S4_SETEX_with_expiry.spec: Accept SETEX <key> <seconds> <value>, set with expiration, expired keys treated as non-existent.
S4_SETEX_with_expiry.evidence: _handle_setex (L243-265): validates seconds as int (ValueError → ERR unknown_command), enforces key/value/store constraints, stores expiry = time.time()+seconds. Expired keys cleaned by _is_expired in GET/DEL/EXISTS/TTL.
edge_cases_verified: SETEX with non-integer seconds → ERR unknown_command
SET overwriting SETEX key clears expiry
SETEX seconds negative → key immediately expired

S5_APPEND_create_or_append.spec: Accept APPEND <key> <value>, append to existing or create new, return OK <new_length>.
S5_APPEND_create_or_append.evidence: _handle_append (L215-239): calls _is_expired first, appends to existing or creates new. Enforces key_too_long, value_too_large (post-concatenation), store_full (new keys only). Returns f'OK {len(result)}'.
edge_cases_verified: append to existing → OK + new length
concat overflow → ERR value_too_large, original unchanged
append to expired key → treats as new

Y1_RENAME.spec: Accept RENAME <old_key> <new_key>, rename key, OK or ERR key_not_found.
Y1_RENAME.evidence: _handle_rename (L286-301): validates old_key exists, new_key length, migrates _data.pop(old_key) and _expiry.pop(old_key). Returns 'OK' or 'ERR key_not_found'.

Y2_TYPE.spec: Accept TYPE <key>, return STRING or INTEGER, ERR key_not_found if missing.
Y2_TYPE.evidence: _handle_type (L303-315): _is_expired first, then isdigit() or negative-integer pattern match. Returns 'INTEGER' or 'STRING'.

Y3_DUMP.spec: Accept DUMP (no arguments), return all key=value pairs (<key>=<value> per line), terminated by END.
Y3_DUMP.evidence: _handle_dump (L317-323): calls _cleanup_all_expired, formats k=v per line, appends 'END'. Empty store → just 'END'.

response_format_consistency.detail: All errors use unified 'ERR <error_code>' format. All 5 error codes consistently applied: unknown_command (L63,71,75,169,253), key_not_found (L121,130,273,294,309), key_too_long (L106,182,257,223,297), value_too_large (L108,184,228,233,259), store_full (L110,194,235,261).

constraint_check_chain_order.detail: Constraint checks follow declared chain: command_parse → arg_count → key_length(>64) → value_size(>1024) → store_capacity(>=100 && key not exists). Verified in _handle_set, _handle_mset, _handle_setex, _handle_append. No constraint skipped or reordered.

store_full_update_carveout.detail: All commands adding new keys (SET L109, MSET L193, SETEX L260, APPEND L234) correctly allow updates to existing keys even at capacity via 'key not in self._data' guard.

multi_key_DEL_extension.detail: executor2 extended DEL to support multi-key atomic deletion (beyond spec's single-key DEL). Single-key behavior preserved. Response 'OK 1' (single) / 'OK N' (multi) conforms to 'OK <detail>' per Response Format. No spec requirement violated. Existing test 'OK' in r remains compatible.

command_case_insensitivity.detail: execute() L65: cmd = parts[0].upper(). All commands accept lowercase (set, get, del, etc.).

integration_scenarios.result: PASS — value returned → OK → ERR key_not_found → FALSE
PASS — immediately expired, returns ERR key_not_found
PASS — all pairs rolled back, nothing written
PASS — creates new key, returns OK <length>

existing_test_compatibility.detail: Code inspection confirms all 15 assertions in tests/test_protocol.py pass against current implementation. Key change: DEL now returns 'OK 1' instead of 'OK', but test uses substring match 'OK' in r.
